shall be assumed by the Surviving Corporation, without further action, at the Effective Time

claim.raw_value: or any indemnification agreement between such Indemnified Party and the Company or any of the Company Subsidiaries set forth on Section 6.05(a) of the Company Disclosure Letter

attributes.why_unmapped: INDEMNIFICATION_AGREEMENT: Existing indemnification agreements listed in the disclosure letter are included.

claim.raw_value: including reasonable attorneys’ fees and expenses in advance of the final disposition of any Proceeding to each Indemnified Party to the fullest extent permitted by applicable Law upon receipt of appropriate undertakings in favor of Parent and/or the Surviving Corporation to repay such advanced costs and expenses if it is ultimately determined in a final and non-appealable judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction that such Indemnified Party is not entitled to be indemnified under this Section 6.05(b)

claim.raw_value: Parent and the Surviving Corporation shall at their own expense cooperate with an Indemnified Party in the defense of any matter for which such Indemnified Party could seek indemnification hereunder; provided that Parent and the Surviving Corporation shall be entitled to control and appoint lead counsel for such defense.

attributes.why_unmapped: CLAIMS_HANDLING: Parent and the Surviving Corporation must cooperate at their expense and may control the defence and appoint lead counsel.

claim.raw_value: all rights to indemnification in respect of any Proceeding asserted or made within such period shall continue until the final disposition of such Proceeding.

attributes.why_unmapped: PENDING_CLAIM_SURVIVAL: Timely asserted or made proceedings continue through final disposition.

claim.raw_value: Parent shall cause proper provision to be made so that the applicable successors and assigns or transferees expressly assume the obligations set forth in this Section 6.05.

attributes.why_unmapped: SUCCESSOR_ASSUMPTION: Successors, assigns, or transferees must expressly assume the Section 6.05 obligations in specified transactions.

claim.raw_value: Parent shall pay all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket expenses, including reasonable attorneys’ fees, that may be incurred by any Indemnified Party in successfully enforcing the indemnity and other obligations provided in this Section 6.05.

attributes.why_unmapped: FEE_SHIFTING: Parent pays reasonable documented enforcement expenses and attorneys’ fees when an Indemnified Party successfully enforces the obligations.
